item.title: Engie to build biomethane plant in France to fuel CMA CGM's fleet
item.description: French energy group Engie said on Tuesday it plans to develop a biomethane production facility in northern France with shipping firm CMA CGM, supporting the carrier's transition to lower-emission fuels.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French energy group Engie (ENGIE.PA) said on Tuesday it plans to develop a biomethane production facility in northern France with shipping firm CMA CGM, supporting the carrier's transition to lower-emission fuels. Financial terms of the project, in which CMA CGM will be a minority shareholder, were not disclosed. Under a preliminary agreement, Engie will develop a plant near the port of Le Havre to produce 7,000 metric tons of biomethane annually, equivalent to 100 gigawatt-hours (GWh) The partners aim to begin production by 2029/2030, using agricultural and other organic waste, to supply CMA CGM through a mass-balance equivalent contribution CMA CGM, the world's third-largest container shipping line, has invested in vessels powered by liquefied natural gas as [USN:L1N3Z80J5 TEXT:"the industry seeks alternatives"] to traditional fuel Engie and CMA CGM had previously planned to produce 11,000 tons of biomethane a year at Le Havre in a €150 million ($167.84 million) project using wood waste, before dropping the plans ($1 = 0.8937 euros)

item.title: Alemania envía cazas de combate por fallo técnico que provocó falsa alerta de secuestro aéreo
item.description: Un vuelo de Grecia a Alemania aterrizó sin incidentes en Núremberg el martes después de que una alerta de secuestro de la cabina —que la aerolínea atribuyó a un fallo técnico— provocara que la Fuerza Aérea alemana movilizara dos aviones de combate.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un vuelo de Grecia a Alemania aterrizó sin incidentes en Núremberg el martes después de que una alerta de secuestro de la cabina —que la aerolínea atribuyó a un fallo técnico— provocara que la Fuerza Aérea alemana movilizara dos aviones de combate. Corendon Airlines achacó el incidente a un fallo en el sistema de comunicaciones por radio y afirmó que "no se produjo ninguna situación de emergencia y que en ningún momento los pasajeros, la tripulación ni la aeronave corrieron peligro alguno". El incidente, ocurrido en el Boeing (BA.N) 737-800 que había despegado de la isla griega de Corfú, obligó a suspender brevemente las operaciones en el aeropuerto de Núremberg, destino previsto del avión, informó el aeropuerto. Posteriormente, las operaciones volvieron a la normalidad. "Desde la cabina se transmitió el código '7500' (caso de secuestro) y, además, ya no se pudo contactar con el piloto por radio. Por razones de seguridad, se activaron entonces varias alertas de emergencia", declaró la policía alemana en la red social X. Un portavoz de la Fuerza Aérea alemana indicó que dos aviones Eurofighter despegaron de la base aérea de Neuburg, en el sur de Alemania, y escoltaron al avión de pasajeros hasta su aterrizaje. Alemania cuenta con dos de estas escuadras de alerta, cada una con dos aviones de combate, para evaluar la situación cuando se pierde la comunicación con las tripulaciones de aviones civiles, lo que ocurre aproximadamente una o dos veces al mes, según la página web de la Fuerza Aérea. La alerta se produce menos de un mes después de que el copiloto de un avión con destino a Israel procedente de Dubái atacara al piloto con un hacha de emergencia, un incidente que el fiscal general de Emiratos Árabes Unidos calificó de "ataque terrorista". Corendon, con sede en Turquía, dijo que el código de emergencia se transmitió sobre el espacio aéreo croata "debido a un breve fallo en el sistema de comunicaciones por radio.La situación se supervisó de inmediato, se iniciaron rápidamente las investigaciones y se tomaron todas las medidas necesarias. La aeronave aterrizó sin incidentes en el aeropuerto de Núremberg".

item.title: India's CtrlS to invest $1.05 billion to build hyperscale AI factory in eastern India
item.description: Indian data center operator CtrlS on Tuesday said it will invest 100 billion rupees ($1.05 billion) to set up a 150-megawatt hyperscale AI factory in Bodh Gaya in the eastern Indian state of Bihar.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian data center operator CtrlS on Tuesday said it will invest 100 billion rupees ($1.05 billion) to set up a 150-megawatt hyperscale AI factory in Bodh Gaya in the eastern Indian state of Bihar. The data center facility will support the digital infrastructure needs of government institutions, companies and hyperscalers in Bihar and eastern India, the company said. CtrlS said it had previously invested 4 billion rupees in setting up a data center in Patna in Bihar, which currently has a capacity of 12 megawatts, with scope to expand in line with future demand. The company plans to set up more than 20 edge data centers in smaller cities in India over the coming years, Sridhar Pinnapureddy, CEO, said in a statement. CtrlS currently operates 19 data centers in India. Several Indian companies have committed to data center investments in the country this year, including IT services company HCLTech (HCLT.NS) and engineering and construction conglomerate L&T (LART.NS) . ($1 = 95.2800 Indian rupees)

item.title: Casa Blanca afirma que pidió a su embajadora en Grecia que dimita
item.description: La Casa Blanca comunicó el martes que ha pedido a la embajadora de Estados Unidos en Grecia, Kimberly Guilfoyle, que dimita.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage , Trevor Hunnicutt
item.content:encoded: La Casa Blanca comunicó el martes que ha pedido a la embajadora de Estados Unidos en Grecia, Kimberly Guilfoyle, que dimita. "Hemos pedido a la embajadora Guilfoyle que dimita", declaró la portavoz de la Casa Blanca, Katie Zacharia, en una rueda de prensa. "Ha sido un gran activo para el equipo y le deseamos lo mejor". El presidente Donald Trump afirmó el lunes que estaba considerando despedir a Guilfoyle, y dijo a periodistas: "No estamos contentos". Los legisladores estadounidenses ya habían expresado su preocupación por las acusaciones de que Guilfoyle podría haber amenazado con utilizar la influencia de Estados Unidos para socavar al Gobierno griego. La embajada de Washington en Atenas no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios dirigida a Guilfoyle. Grecia ha sido un importante aliado de Estados Unidos en la OTAN, al ofrecer instalaciones militares clave para garantizar la seguridad en el Mediterráneo oriental, y lidera una misión marítima de la Unión Europea para proteger la navegación comercial en el mar Rojo.

item.title: Nvidia to buy a minority stake in France's Doctolib
item.description: U.S. chip maker Nvidia has agreed to buy a minority stake in French health care platform Doctolib, the French company said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: U.S. chip maker Nvidia (NVDA.O) has agreed to buy a minority stake in French health care platform Doctolib, the French company said on Tuesday. item.title: Shell to sell its Nigeria gas business to Vaaris Energy
item.description: Shell said on Tuesday it has signed an agreement to sell its full interest in the Shell Nigeria Gas Group, which operates a domestic gas distribution business in the country, to Vaaris Energy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shell (SHEL.L) said on Tuesday it has signed an agreement to sell its full interest in the Shell Nigeria Gas Group, which operates a domestic gas distribution business in the country, to Vaaris Energy. Here are more details: The sale is a part of CEO Wael Sawan's ongoing efforts to simplify Shell's portfolio and shift focus away from renewables, seeking better returns in oil and gas projects "Shell continues to focus on strategic Deepwater and Integrated Gas positions in Nigeria," said Elohor Aiboni, Shell’s Country Chair in Nigeria The companies did not disclose the monetary value of the sale Last week, the oil major [USN:L4N45T0DM TEXT:"raised"] its third-quarter integrated gas production forecast to between 740,000 and 780,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day, from a previous estimate of 570,000 to 630,000 boepd Vaaris Energy is a privately held Nigerian energy company with interests across the oil and gas value chain and an existing operational footprint in the country

item.title: Copeland, Dixell refrigeration systems also hacked, French cybersecurity agency says
item.description: France's cybersecurity agency said on Tuesday that the refrigeration systems of Copeland and Dixell were also hacked during a cyberattack that targeted supermarket refrigerators and freezers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: France's cybersecurity agency said on Tuesday that the refrigeration systems of Copeland and Dixell were also hacked [USN:L8N45Y11U TEXT:"during a cyberattack"] that targeted supermarket refrigerators and freezers. A spokesperson for Copeland, which owns Dixell, declined to confirm the information and said the company's top priority is to protect customers' operations. Hackers raised temperatures of refrigerators in hundreds of supermarkets to as high as 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit), causing fires and spoiling food.

item.title: Citigroup turns cautious on US stocks as market exuberance flashes warning signs
item.description: Citigroup dropped its "overweight" call on US equities and closed its long position in the S&P 500 Equal Weight index on Tuesday, saying it is taking some risk off the table as signs of market exuberance build. Here are some details:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Citigroup dropped its "overweight" call on US equities and closed its long position in the S&P 500 Equal Weight index (.EWGSPC) on Tuesday, saying it is taking some risk off the table as signs of market exuberance build. Here are some details: The brokerage said its POLLS indicator, which tracks positioning, optimism, liquidity, leverage and stress, recently reached levels that have historically coincided with market peaks "We tactically take some risk off the table," the brokerage said The S&P 500 Equal Weight index tracks the same 500 companies as the traditional S&P 500 (.SPX) but gives each stock roughly equal weight, reducing the influence of mega-cap companies and offering a broader gauge The move reflects growing caution over stretched market sentiment, although Citi stopped short of turning bearish on stocks Citi said it is growing more cautious on equities as market gains appear increasingly vulnerable to signs of trouble, although it is not advocating a broad flight to safety Conversely, Goldman Sachs [USN:L4N45Y0PZ TEXT:"upgraded global equities"] to "overweight" on Monday, citing more attractive valuations following the recent market pullback

item.title: Google launches flagship AI model Gemini 4 Argon for developers, businesses
item.description: Alphabet's Google on Wednesday released its flagship AI model Gemini 4 Argon to developers and businesses worldwide, seeking to regain ground against rivals OpenAI and Anthropic after months of delays and a leadership shakeup at its DeepMind lab.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google on Wednesday released its flagship AI model Gemini 4 Argon to developers and businesses worldwide, seeking to regain ground against rivals OpenAI and Anthropic after months of delays and a leadership shakeup at its DeepMind lab. The model excels at "deep work" on complex, multi-step tasks in coding, finance, law, cybersecurity and science, Google said. API pricing at launch starts at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with rates set to double after November 30. The release follows a rocky stretch in Google's AI efforts. The company announced in September that it [USN:L6N45M1AK TEXT:"no longer planned"] to release Gemini 3.5 Pro, which CEO Sundar Pichai had originally said would be released in June. It also [USN:L6N442125 TEXT:"overhauled DeepMind"] after the AI lab's co-founder and CEO Demis Hassabis stepped aside and several leaders of its Gemini model left the company. Argon is available to paying customers through the company's AI application building tools. Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers can access it through the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search, while the Antigravity coding tool is limited to Ultra subscribers. Teams using Argon in Antigravity increased agentic code submissions by more than 35%, while reducing code rollbacks by nearly a third, Google said. Customers testing the model early include Deloitte, LexisNexis, Ambience Healthcare and Isomorphic Labs. Meanwhile, Google said it would open its Fairwind Program to hundreds of additional partners. The program gives vetted cybersecurity defenders a version of Argon without its cyber guardrails. In September, the company had said it was providing the model to select cybersecurity partners. Separately, Google will offer 10,000 scientists six months of free access to Antigravity's highest usage tier.

item.title: ULTIM'ORA-UCRAINA: Usa continuano a condividere informazioni di intelligence con Kiev - Trump
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina: 17.45 - Il presidente Usa Donald Trump ha detto che gli Stati Uniti continuano a condividere informazioni di intelligence con l’Ucraina e che auspicano la fine della guerra. "Li stiamo aiutando e condividiamo informazioni di intelligence", ha detto Trump ai giornalisti. "Vogliamo che la guerra finisca, quindi stiamo collaborando con loro e con la Russia per porre fine al conflitto". 12.00 - Il Cremlino ha detto che proseguono i contatti relativi alla tregua energetica tra Russia e Ucraina annunciata domenica dal presidente degli Stati Uniti Donald Trump, ma che per il momento non ha altro da aggiungere al riguardo. 11.40 - L'Ucraina ha sospeso per due giorni gli attacchi alle raffinerie di petrolio russe e alle altre infrastrutture energetiche del Paese, in seguito all'annuncio del presidente degli Stati Uniti Donald Trump di una tregua energetica. Lo ha detto il presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelensky, aggiungendo che la Russia non si è però astenuta dagli attacchi. 10.55 - La Nato continuerà ad adeguare la propria presenza militare sul fianco orientale “secondo necessità”, ha detto il segretario generale dell’alleanza Mark Rutte, a seguito di un attacco con droni contro alcune navi al largo della costa bulgara sul Mar Nero. 18.30 - La presidente della Commissione europea Ursula von der Leyen ha condannato gli attacchi con droni contro navi mercantili al largo delle coste bulgare e ha chiesto che i responsabili siano chiamati a rispondere delle loro azioni. "Il Mar Nero è diventato un altro fronte dell’escalation della guerra russa in Ucraina. È inaccettabile", ha detto von der Leyen su X. "I responsabili devono essere chiamati a rispondere delle loro azioni".

item.title: Trump says US still sharing intel with Ukraine, defends Russian diesel deal
item.description: President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that the United States continues to share intelligence with Ukraine and is working with both Kyiv and Moscow to bring an end to the war.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage , Nandita Bose
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that the United States continues to share intelligence with Ukraine and is working with both Kyiv and Moscow to bring an end to the war. "We are helping them, and we are sharing intel," Trump told reporters. "We want the war to end, so we're working with them and Russia on getting the war to end." Trump said both Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy want the war to end, but "there is a lot of hatred between the two of them" and they "don't know how to get there." Trump was also asked about [USN:L1N45Y0GJ TEXT:"a deal involving Russian diesel"] that has drawn criticism from US lawmakers in both parties, who say it appears to violate US restrictions on Russian energy imports imposed over Moscow's invasion of Ukraine. Asked whether Russia could use proceeds from the diesel deal to purchase more bombs, Trump sidestepped the question. "That's a diesel deal, not for us. That's being released into the world. That's not being released to us."

item.title: Amnistía acusa a F1 de ofrecer a Ruanda un "blanqueo deportivo" con acuerdo sobre carreras
item.description: La organización de defensa de los derechos humanos Amnistía Internacional acusó a la Fórmula 1 de hacer promesas vacías y de ofrecer a Ruanda un premio de "blanqueo deportivo" con el acuerdo de 10 años anunciado el martes para celebrar el Gran Premio de África.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La organización de defensa de los derechos humanos Amnistía Internacional acusó a la Fórmula 1 de hacer promesas vacías y de ofrecer a Ruanda un premio de "blanqueo deportivo" con el acuerdo de 10 años anunciado el martes para celebrar el Gran Premio de África. El acuerdo histórico prevé la organización de una carrera a principios de la década de 2030, en un circuito que aún está por construirse cerca de un nuevo aeropuerto internacional al sur de Kigali. Será la primera carrera en África desde 1993. "Un Gran Premio de 10 años 'presentado por Visit Rwanda' es un premio de 'blanqueo deportivo' para las autoridades ruandesas", dijo Felix Jakens, responsable de campañas de Amnistía Internacional Reino Unido, en una respuesta por escrito. "El Arsenal, el Aston Villa, los campeonatos mundiales de ciclismo y ahora la Fórmula 1: Ruanda está apostando por los deportes más importantes del mundo para pulir su imagen y desviar la atención de su atroz historial en materia de derechos humanos". "La F1 dice que el deporte puede ser 'una fuerza positiva para el bien'. Eso suena a falso si la F1 hace caso omiso de con quién se asocia. Las autoridades de Ruanda son propensas a las detenciones arbitrarias, la tortura y la represión de la libertad de expresión; estos son abusos que cometen en su propio país". El Gobierno ruandés no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters. La acusación de "blanqueo deportivo" se dirige contra países que, según se percibe, utilizan el deporte para mejorar una imagen empañada en el extranjero. Varios otros países anfitriones de la F1, principalmente en Oriente Medio, han sido acusados de ello. El acuerdo de patrocinio del Aston Villa, equipo de la Premier League, con Visit Rwanda suscitó críticas similares por parte de defensores de los derechos humanos en julio. La oficina de turismo del país africano también tiene acuerdos de patrocinio con el Atlético de Madrid y el París Saint-Germain, así como con equipos deportivos estadounidenses como Los Angeles Clippers y Los Angeles Rams. Además, su logotipo apareció en las mangas de la camiseta del Arsenal durante ocho temporadas. El presidente de Ruanda, Paul Kagame, se ha ganado el reconocimiento de líderes occidentales y regionales por haber contribuido a poner fin al genocidio de 1994 en Ruanda y por haber reconstruido el país hasta convertirlo en un destino atractivo para la inversión y la ayuda. También se le acusa de reprimir a los críticos en su país y de apoyar al grupo rebelde M23 en la vecina República Democrática del Congo, el que, según las organizaciones de derechos humanos, es culpable de asesinatos, violaciones y otras violaciones de los derechos humanos. Kagame dijo en una rueda de prensa en Kigali que el acuerdo situaría a Ruanda en un camino "que cambiará la forma en que se percibe a África en el mundo del deporte. Consideramos a Ruanda en el contexto de todo un continente", añadió. Un portavoz de la F1 dijo que este deporte tenía "la oportunidad de inspirar y llevar la pasión de la F1 a 100 millones de personas en toda África, y que el deporte puede ser una fuerza positiva para el bien". Jakens instó a la F1 a impulsar el cambio "en lugar de prestar su marca a una maniobra de relaciones públicas".

item.title: Trump says Yemen's Houthis are 'behaving very badly'
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Tuesday said Houthi militants who control vast swaths of Yemen were "behaving very badly" as consequences of the US-Iran war spill into the broader Middle East.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Tuesday said Houthi militants who control vast swaths of Yemen were "behaving very badly" as consequences of the US-Iran war spill into the broader Middle East. The Iran-backed Houthis have been battling the Saudi-backed Yemeni government in a civil war since 2014, but the conflict has intensified since the US began its eight-month war on Iran. The group has recently escalated attacks on commercial shipping in the Red Sea and the vital Bab al-Mandab Strait. The [USN:S8N44G01P TEXT:"Houthis launched attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport"] in recent days, killing 13 people, wounding more than 300, and closing the skies above the Saudi capital. Trump told reporters that he "might" ask Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan to intervene and support Saudi interests. "President Erdogan, I think, would do as I ask," Trump said.

item.title: US Senate report says spending on consultants for internet subsidy program tops $200 million annually
item.description: A US Senate committee report released on Tuesday said consultants who assist schools and libraries in winning funding from a $3 billion annual internet subsidy program receive between $200 million and $400 million annually.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A US Senate committee report released on Tuesday said consultants who assist schools and libraries in winning funding from a $3 billion annual internet subsidy program receive between $200 million and $400 million annually. Senate Commerce Committee chair Ted Cruz said consultants help the applicants for the Federal Communications Commission E-Rate program "comply with a Byzantine process that has become a costly feature of the program." He added that the high fees should "prompt greater scrutiny of how E-Rate funds move, who benefits and whether the program's current structure delivers value to schools, libraries and taxpayers."

item.title: Boeing a livré 57 avions en septembre, son meilleur mois depuis le début de l'année
item.description: Boeing a annoncé mardi avoir livré 57 avions en septembre, après 51 en août et 55 un an plus tôt, marquant son meilleur résultat mensuel depuis le début de l'année.
item.dc:creator: Dan Catchpole
item.content:encoded: Boeing (BA.N) a annoncé mardi avoir livré 57 avions en septembre, après 51 en août et 55 un an plus tôt, marquant son meilleur résultat mensuel depuis le début de l'année. Le constructeur aéronautique américain reste toutefois derrière Airbus, qui a livré [USN:S8N3ZG05H TEXT:"72 appareils"] en septembre. Boeing a néanmoins largement devancé son rival européen en termes de commandes, avec 165 nouvelles commandes en septembre, dont 100 appareils 737 MAX par Turkish Airlines. Airbus n'a enregistré que 17 nouvelles commandes de deux clients le mois dernier. Les livraisons de Boeing en septembre comprenaient 43 avions 737 MAX, huit 787, deux avions-cargos 777 et quatre 767, dont trois destinés à l'unité de défense de Boeing pour être transformés en avions de ravitaillement en vol KC-46. Cette hausse des livraisons intervient alors que Boeing s'efforce d'augmenter la production de son monocouloir phare, le 737 MAX, pour atteindre 47 appareils par mois. Le président-directeur général de Boeing, Kelly Ortberg, a toutefois prévenu en septembre, lors d'une conférence avec les investisseurs, que le processus avait pris plus de temps que prévu à mettre en place. Sur les neuf premiers mois de l'année, Boeing a livré 475 avions, soit une hausse de 8% sur un an. Ce chiffre comprend 363 appareils 737 MAX, un record pour ce modèle au cours des neuf premiers mois de l'année. Outre la commande de Turkish Airlines, Boeing a enregistré des commandes pour 20 Boeing 737 MAX par Lufthansa (LHAG.DE) , six Boeing 737 MAX et cinq Boeing 787 par Biman Bangladesh Airlines, ainsi que huit Boeing 777-8 cargo et deux Boeing 777 cargo par Ethiopian Airlines. Six autres commandes de Boeing 737 MAX et 18 Boeing 787 proviennent de clients non identifiés. Boeing a clôturé le mois de septembre avec un carnet de commandes officiel de 6.371 avions, contre 6.156 à la fin du mois d’août.

item.title: Le Hezbollah présente un plan d'aide aux Libanais déplacés
item.description: Le Hezbollah va verser une aide pouvant atteindre 14.000 dollars (12.500 euros) aux familles dont le domicile principal a été détruit ou rendu inhabitable au cours du conflit contre Israël cette année, a annoncé mardi le président du conseil exécutif du mouvement armé libanais.
item.dc:creator: Maya Gebeily, Laila Bassam
item.content:encoded: Le Hezbollah va verser une aide pouvant atteindre 14.000 dollars (12.500 euros) aux familles dont le domicile principal a été détruit ou rendu inhabitable au cours du conflit contre Israël cette année, a annoncé mardi le président du conseil exécutif du mouvement armé libanais. Citant deux personnes ayant une connaissance directe de ce transfert d'argent, Reuters a rapporté la semaine dernière que le Hezbollah avait reçu 200 millions de dollars de l'Iran pour lui permettre de venir en aide aux familles libanaises déplacées, même si les Etats-Unis ont dit douter de la capacité de Téhéran à fournir une telle assistance financière. L'Iran n'a pas commenté les informations de Reuters. Aux termes du plan présenté par le président du conseil exécutif du Hezbollah, Ali Damouch, les familles éligibles à Beyrouth et dans la banlieue sud de la capitale libanaise recevront 14.000 dollars, dont 8.000 dollars pour l'ameublement de leur logement et 6.000 dollars pour le loyer. Les familles résidant ailleurs au Liban recevront 12.000 dollars, répartis en 8.000 dollars pour l'ameublement et 4.000 dollars pour le loyer, des montants inchangés par rapport à 2024. Ali Damouch a précisé que seraient éligibles les familles dont les logements ont été détruits, jugés inhabitables à la suite d'un examen technique ou fortement endommagés, ainsi que les familles déplacées des secteurs occupés par Israël et de leurs environs. En soutien à Téhéran, le Hezbollah s'est engagé le 2 mars dans le conflit déclenché l'avant-veille par des frappes des Etats-Unis et d'Israël contre l'Iran. La campagne de bombardements contre Beyrouth et les bastions du mouvement chiite libanais et l'invasion terrestre du Sud-Liban menées par l'armée israélienne ont fait des centaines de milliers de déplacés, outre les plus de 4.300 morts recensés par le ministère libanais de la Santé, qui n'établit pas de distinction entre civils et combattants. Ali Damouch a refusé mardi de commenter aussi bien les informations de Reuters sur le transfert de fonds iraniens dont aurait bénéficié le Hezbollah le mois dernier que la réaction des Etats-Unis, lesquels jugent que cet argent "n'existe pas". Il a aussi refusé de fournir le montant total de l'enveloppe que son mouvement consacrera à cette aide aux déplacés.

item.title: Yémen La coalition saoudienne ordonne d'évacuer un site pétrolier à Sanaa, les Houthis signalent une attaque
item.description: La coalition armée dirigée par l'Arabie saoudite a appelé mardi la population civile à évacuer la zone de la station centrale d'Al-Sabah, une installation pétrolière située à Sanaa, la capitale yéménite, en vue d'une opération militaire.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La coalition armée dirigée par l'Arabie saoudite a appelé mardi la population civile à évacuer la zone de la station centrale d'Al-Sabah, une installation pétrolière située à Sanaa, la capitale yéménite, en vue d'une opération militaire. La chaîne de télévision des Houthis, Al-Masirah, a rapporté par la suite une attaque contre la station centrale, qui appartient à la Compagnie pétrolière yéménite. Un porte-parole militaire de la rébellion pro-iranienne des Houthis, Yahya Saree, a déclaré sur X que toute attaque contre Sanaa entraînerait une riposte "sévère et douloureuse" contre Ryad, la capitale d'Arabie saoudite. Sanaa, dans l'ouest du Yémen, est contrôlée depuis septembre 2014 par les Houthis. Le gouvernement yéménite reconnu par la communauté internationale se trouve dans la ville portuaire d'Aden (sud). Le mouvement chiite, qui contrôle également une grande partie du nord et de l'ouest du Yémen, a émis un ordre d'évacuation à destination des employés des sites de Saudi Aramco, la compagnie nationale saoudienne d'hydrocarbures, ainsi que les civils résidant à proximité, expliquant que ces infrastructures constituaient des cibles légitimes.

item.title: Le nombre de cas d'Ebola en RDC dépasse les 9.000 - données
item.description: Le nombre de cas confirmés d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo (RDC) dépasse désormais les 9.000, selon des données gouvernementales publiées mardi.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le nombre de cas confirmés d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo (RDC) dépasse désormais les 9.000, selon des données gouvernementales publiées mardi. La 17e épidémie d'Ebola en RDC est devenue, depuis la fin juillet, la plus importante de l'histoire du pays en termes de nombre de cas et le bilan des décès s'élève à 4.381 morts, selon l'Institut de santé publique, [USN:L8N44D06P TEXT:"dépassant"] ainsi la précédente épidémie la plus grave, survenue entre 2018 et 2020. L'institut a recensé à ce jour 9.066 cas, selon son dernier rapport de situation, ce qui en fait la deuxième épidémie d'Ebola la plus grave au monde, derrière celle qui a sévi en Afrique de l'Ouest de 2014 à 2016, tant en termes de cas que de décès. Cette dernière avait infecté plus de 28.600 personnes et fait plus de 11.000 victimes dans une zone couvrant la Guinée, le Liberia et le Sierra Leone. L'épidémie actuelle est causée par la souche Bundibugyo du virus Ebola, pour laquelle il n'existe ni vaccin ni traitement approuvé. Elle s'est étendue à d'autres : L'Ouganda a signalé 20 cas et deux décès plus tôt dans l'année - mais le pays a depuis déclaré la [USN:L6N43U0ZT TEXT:"fin"] de l'épidémie sur son territoire. La semaine dernière, le Kenya a [USN:L6N45S0ST TEXT:"confirmé"] son premier cas d'Ebola après le décès à Nairobi d'un ressortissant kenyan revenant d'un séjour en République démocratique du Congo (RDC).

item.title: France Le parquet antiterroriste se saisit de l'enquête sur les tirs au collège d'Aubagne
item.description: Le parquet national antiterroriste a annoncé mardi se saisir de l'enquête sur l'intrusion armée au collège Joseph-Lakanal d'Aubagne (Bouches-du-Rhône) d'un élève de l'établissement qui a ouvert le feu au fusil de chasse sur le proviseur et une enseignante, les blessant légèrement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le parquet national antiterroriste a annoncé mardi se saisir de l'enquête sur l'intrusion armée au collège Joseph-Lakanal d'Aubagne (Bouches-du-Rhône) d'un élève de l'établissement qui a ouvert le feu au fusil de chasse sur le proviseur et une enseignante, les blessant légèrement. Le parquet de Marseille, qui avait diligenté lundi une enquête pour "tentatives d'assassinats", s'est dessaisi au profit du PNAT car les premières investigations ont mis en évidence "la probable adhésion" du mineur "à la mouvance True Crime Community (TCC) ainsi que l’inscription de l’action criminelle intervenue au sein de son établissement scolaire dans cette idéologie", précise le parquet antiterroriste dans un communiqué. Une enquête est désormais ouverte des chefs de "tentatives d’assassinats en relation avec une entreprise terroriste, association de malfaiteurs terroriste en vue de crimes contre les personnes et infractions à la législation sur les armes, en relation avec une entreprise terroriste". L'intérêt de l'adolescent de 14 ans pour la nébuleuse "True Crime Community" a été mis au jour lors de l'exploitation de ses supports numériques. La mouvance TCC, indique le PNAT, est "un écosystème de communautés numériques qui glorifie les auteurs de tuerie de masse et incite, dans certaines formes, au recours à la violence extrême." Des photos, des vidéos, des documents judiciaires, des lettres ou des dessins représentant des criminels célèbres ou des auteurs d'attentats sont ainsi partagés au sein de ces communautés. L'adolescent, scolarisé en troisième, a été interpellé et placé en garde à vue lundi matin après avoir été désarmé et maîtrisé par un membre du personnel éducatif. Il était entré peu après 09h00 dans son collège avec un fusil de chasse dissimulé dans un étui à guitare. Dans un premier temps, il ouvert le feu dans le couloir du premier étage du bâtiment, blessant aux membres inférieurs le principal et une professeure, selon le récit des faits établi par le parquet de Marseille. L'adolescent, qui n'a pour l'heure rien dit du mobile de son geste, a poursuivi sa progression au deuxième étage où il a tiré une première fois devant une professeure en direction du sol et une deuxième fois à l'intérieur d'une salle de classe occupée, le tir atteignant le tableau. Le ministre de l'Education nationale, Edouard Geffray, a déclaré mardi matin sur France Inter que le jeune homme, dont les parents ont été placés en garde à vue, "avait clairement une intention de tuer". "Ce qui est frappant, c'est qu'il y a un caractère prémédité. (...) On est face à un jeune qui a organisé son périple. Il a eu le temps de recharger à plusieurs reprises" son fusil, a-t-il ajouté.

item.title: US Treasury yields yet to peak as Fed may tighten further, PIMCO's Ivascyn says
item.description: US Treasury yields may have further room to rise, with the Federal Reserve likely to deliver one or two more rate increases before the current tightening cycle ends, Dan Ivascyn, chief investment officer at the world's largest bond manager, told Reuters on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
item.content:encoded: US Treasury yields may have further room to rise, with the Federal Reserve likely to deliver one or two more rate increases before the current tightening cycle ends, Dan Ivascyn, chief investment officer at the world's largest bond manager, told Reuters on Tuesday. Speaking on the sidelines of the Grant's Fall Conference, Ivascyn said he expects the Fed to keep rates unchanged later this month, but sees scope for one or two additional hikes. "We'll probably see a Fed on hold now, and they probably go one more time this year," he said. "Our own view is that one to two tightenings, given the current outlook."

item.title: Martin Shkreli violated lifetime pharma industry ban, FTC and states say
item.description: Martin Shkreli has violated a lifetime ban from the pharmaceutical industry by trading stocks and discussing his opinions about companies in the industry, federal and state regulators said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Martin Shkreli has violated a lifetime ban from the pharmaceutical industry by trading stocks and discussing his opinions about companies in the industry, federal and state regulators said on Tuesday. In a court filing, the Federal Trade Commission and a coalition of seven states asked US District Judge Denise Cote to hold Shkreli in contempt and issue a fine equal to his profits from trading pharmaceutical company stocks since February 4, 2022. A lawyer for Shkreli did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Shkreli, as the chief executive of Turing Pharmaceuticals, became known as "pharma bro" after raising the price of the anti-parasitic drug Daraprim to $750 per tablet from $17.50 in 2015, and appearing unapologetic when criticized. Cote in 2022 found Shkreli liable for violating antitrust laws and imposed the lifetime ban. Shkreli was separately sentenced to seven years in prison after being convicted in 2017 on fraud charges. He was released in 2022.

item.title: Revenda de moradias nos EUA aumenta em setembro; taxas de hipotecas mais altas abalam perspectivas
item.description: As vendas de moradias usadas nos EUA aumentaram inesperadamente em setembro, à medida que o aumento do estoque ofereceu mais opções aos compradores, mas a tendência permaneceu moderada em um cenário de taxas de hipotecas mais altas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As vendas de moradias usadas nos EUA aumentaram inesperadamente em setembro, à medida que o aumento do estoque ofereceu mais opções aos compradores, mas a tendência permaneceu moderada em um cenário de taxas de hipotecas mais altas. As vendas de imóveis subiram 1,5% no mês passado, atingindo uma taxa anual ajustada sazonalmente de 3,99 milhões de unidades, informou a associação nacional de corretores imobiliários (NAR, na sigla em inglês) nesta terça-feira. Economistas consultados pela Reuters previam que as revendas de imóveis recuariam para uma taxa de 3,95 milhões de unidades. As vendas caíram 2,2% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior em setembro. “Apesar do pequeno aumento mensal em termos ajustados sazonalmente, agosto e setembro foram os dois meses mais fracos para as vendas de imóveis este ano”, disse Lawrence Yun, economista-chefe da NAR. “Novos aumentos nas taxas de hipotecas nas últimas semanas significam que menos compradores se qualificam para adquirir um imóvel.” As taxas de hipotecas vêm apresentando uma tendência de alta desde o início do conflito entre EUA, Israel e Irã, no final de fevereiro. O conflito está alimentando a inflação e elevando os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA, aos quais as taxas de hipotecas estão atreladas. A taxa fixa de hipotecas de 30 anos ficou em média em 7,40% na semana passada, o nível mais alto desde novembro de 2023, em comparação com 7,28% na semana anterior, segundo dados da agência de financiamento imobiliário Freddie Mac. A taxa subiu 142 pontos-base desde o final de fevereiro. As vendas aumentaram nas regiões Sul e Oeste, mas caíram no Nordeste e permaneceram estáveis no Centro-Oeste. O estoque de imóveis usados subiu 1,9%, para 1,60 milhão de unidades, o nível mais alto desde novembro de 2019. A oferta ficou 4,6% maior do que há um ano. No ritmo de vendas de setembro, seriam necessários 4,8 meses para esgotar o estoque atual de imóveis usados, sem alteração em relação a agosto, mas acima dos 4,5 meses registrados há um ano. O preço mediano das casas usadas no mês passado aumentou 1,3% em relação ao ano anterior, para US$417.500, o valor mais alto já registrado em setembro. Os compradores de primeira viagem representaram 31% das vendas, um aumento em relação aos 30% registrados em agosto e no ano anterior. É necessária uma participação de 40% nessa categoria para que o mercado imobiliário seja considerado robusto. (Reportagem de Lucia Mutikani)

item.title: Citi-Bénéfice au-dessus des attentes au T3 avec la banque d'investissement, les services et la gestion de patrimoine
item.description: Citigroup a dépassé mardi les attentes de Wall Street concernant son bénéfice du troisième trimestre, porté par la hausse des revenus issus de la banque d'investissement, des transactions avec des multinationales, ainsi qu'à l'augmentation des résultats de la gestion de patrimoine.
item.dc:creator: Tatiana Bautzer, Prakhar Srivastava
item.content:encoded: Citigroup (C.N) a dépassé mardi les attentes de Wall Street concernant son bénéfice du troisième trimestre, porté par la hausse des revenus issus de la banque d'investissement, des transactions avec des multinationales, ainsi qu'à l'augmentation des résultats de la gestion de patrimoine. Les bénéfices liés aux activités de négoce n’ont progressé que de 2% par rapport à l’année dernière et ont reculé de 27% par rapport au trimestre précédent, principalement en raison d’une baisse des revenus issus de la négociation d’actions. Les banques de Wall Street évoluent dans un contexte de marché volatil, le conflit en Iran ayant fait grimper les cours du pétrole. Cela alimente les craintes inflationnistes et pousse la Réserve fédérale américaine à relever ses taux d’intérêt. "Il ne fait aucun doute que les taux d'intérêt élevés et la menace de nouvelles hausses de la Fed pèsent sur les opérations de trading et les activités des courtiers en ligne, avec un impact négatif mesurable", a déclaré Brian Mulberry, stratège en chef des marchés chez Zacks Investment Management. "Toutefois, la capacité de Citi à générer une croissance positive à partir de plusieurs pôles d'activité constitue aujourd'hui la force de son bilan ; la croissance des activités de Services et de Gestion de patrimoine, conjuguée à un solide revenu net d'intérêts (NII), compensera la faiblesse conjoncturelle des activités de marché, permettant ainsi de maintenir le ROTCE au niveau cible de 11% ou au-delà à l'horizon 2027", a-t-il ajouté. L'action de la banque reculait d'environ 0,4% en avant-Bourse à la suite de la publication des résultats. Le chiffre d’affaires de Citigroup a progressé de 9% par rapport à l’année dernière pour atteindre 1,35 milliard de dollars (1,21 milliards d'euros), mais a baissé de 13% par rapport au trimestre précédent, en raison du ralentissement des activités de placement de titres de capital et de dette. Le bénéfice a atteint 5,25 milliards de dollars, soit 2,85 dollars par action, au cours du trimestre clos le 30 septembre. Ce chiffre est à comparer aux 3,8 milliards de dollars, soit 1,86 dollar par action, enregistrés un an plus tôt. Le résultat net de la banque a toutefois reculé de 10% au troisième trimestre par rapport au deuxième. Citigroup a affiché un rendement des fonds propres tangibles de 11,5% au troisième trimestre et un rendement de 12,6% depuis le début de l’année, dépassant ainsi son objectif de 11%. La banque a annoncé un bénéfice de 2,85 dollars par action au troisième trimestre, alors que les analystes tablaient en moyenne sur 2,66 dollars, selon les données compilées par LSEG. L'action Citigroup a progressé de 13% depuis le début de l'année, surperformant l'indice bancaire global (.BKX) . La banque a indiqué avoir redistribué 4,1 milliards de dollars à ses actionnaires au troisième trimestre, sous forme de rachats d’actions et de dividendes, portant le montant total des rachats d’actions à 13,3 milliards de dollars cette année. RALENTISSEMENT DE LA BANQUE D'INVESTISSEMENT ET DU TRADING Le chiffre d’affaires bancaire de Citigroup, qui inclut les prêts aux entreprises, a progressé de 6%, à 1,74 milliard de dollars. Toutefois, les émissions d’actions et de titres de dette ont ralenti en fin de trimestre. Le chiffre d’affaires lié à la souscription d’actions a reculé de 19% par rapport au deuxième trimestre, tout en restant supérieur de 77% à celui de l’année précédente. Les marchés ont été volatils au troisième trimestre et les revenus liés aux opérations de négoce ont augmenté de 6% par rapport à l’année précédente, pour atteindre 6,11 milliards de dollars. Les revenus liés au négoce d’actions ont progressé de 14%, tandis que ceux liés au négoce de titres à revenu fixe ont augmenté de 4%. Citigroup a toutefois enregistré une baisse de 13% de ses revenus de négociation par rapport au deuxième trimestre. BAISSE DES BÉNÉFICES LIÉS AUX CARTES DE CRÉDIT Les bénéfices de la banque liés aux cartes de crédit ont baissé de 8% au troisième trimestre par rapport à l’année précédente. Les clients ont dépensé 13% de plus et ont contracté 9% de prêts supplémentaires, l’économie américaine ayant continué de croître à un rythme soutenu, portée par la résilience des dépenses de consommation et des investissements des entreprises. Cependant, les bénéfices de Citigroup liés aux cartes ont baissé en raison de la hausse des coûts liés aux programmes de fidélité et des paiements versés aux partenaires, ainsi que des provisions pour créances douteuses. Les provisions pour pertes dans son segment des cartes de crédit grand public aux États-Unis se sont élevées à 1,9 milliard de dollars au cours du trimestre, soit 4% de plus qu’il y a un an, les emprunteurs étant confrontés à un ralentissement de la croissance des salaires, à l’inflation et à la hausse des taux d’intérêt.

item.title: BOURSE Wall Street ouvre dans le désordre après les résultats des banques
item.description: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en ordre dispersé mardi alors que les investisseurs analysent les premiers résultats trimestriels des entreprises avec le coup d'envoi donné par les grandes banques américaines.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en ordre dispersé mardi alors que les investisseurs analysent les premiers résultats trimestriels des entreprises avec le coup d'envoi donné par les grandes banques américaines. Dans les premiers échanges, l'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) gagne 415,92 points, soit 0,80%, à 52.266,47 points. Le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large, recule de 6,81 points, soit 0,09%, à 7.800,43 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cède 103,37 points, soit 0,38%, à 27.142,54 points. Le Dow Jones surperforme les deux autres indices de Wall Street qui sont pénalisés par une nouvelle baisse des grandes valeurs technologiques à la suite d'informations selon lesquelles le groupe chinois ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) est en mesure de bousculer le secteur des puces mémoire et de réduire rapidement l'écart technologique avec ses concurrents occidentaux. Le Dow Jones est soutenu notamment par [USN:L6N45Z0QI TEXT:"Goldman Sachs"] (GS.N) (+1,36%) qui a fait état d'une hausse de son bénéfice au troisième trimestre, grâce à une activité de fusions-acquisitions soutenue et à une augmentation des revenus issus du trading. [USN:L6N45Z0Q5 TEXT:"JPMorgan Chase"] (JPM.N) avance de 1,11%, tandis que [USN:L6N45Z0PC TEXT:"Wells Fargo"] (WFC.N) et [USN:L6N45Z0TZ TEXT:"Citigroup"] (C.N) reculent respectivement de 1,14% et 3,71% après leurs résultats trimestriels. Dans la santé, [USN:L6N45Z0RB TEXT:"Johnson & Johnson"] (JNJ.N) cède 0,98% malgré un bénéfice trimestriel meilleur que prévu. UnitedHealth (UNH.N) prend 1,49% après avoir revu à la hausse sa prévision de bénéfice pour 2026, grâce à une réduction des dépenses de santé et à une amélioration des marges dans certaines divisions. La perspective d'une saison des résultats solide a récemment soutenu l'ensemble du marché boursier américain, dans un contexte marqué par des inquiétudes géopolitiques croissantes, la flambée des rendements des obligations d'État et les craintes inflationnistes. Les bénéfices des sociétés du S&P 500 (.SPX) pour le trimestre juillet-septembre devraient progresser de 30,6%, les entreprises des secteurs de la technologie et de l'énergie étant celles qui devraient enregistrer les plus fortes hausses, selon les données compilées par LSEG. Dans le compartiment technologique, les fabricants américains de puces électroniques subissent de nouveau des pressions à la baisse après la vague de ventes de lundi. Le géant des semi-conducteurs Nvidia (NVDA.O) recule de 0,50%, tandis qu'AMD (AMD.O) et Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) perdent respectivement 1,05% et 2,36%. Le fabricant de puces mémoire Micron Technology (MU.O) chute de 4,21%, tandis que les sociétés de stockage de données comme Western Digital (WDC.O) , Seagate (STX.O) et Sandisk (SNDK.O) cèdent entre 3,61% et 5,84%. * Pour les valeurs à suivre, cliquez sur [USN:L8N45Z0O4]

item.title: Jerry Jones: Cowboys DC Christian Parker not 'overwhelmed'
item.description: Christian Parker is shifting to the coaching box from the field as the Cowboys add Mike Pettine to the staff as a consultant, but owner Jerry Jones denies his 32-year-old defensive coordinator is "overwhelmed."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Christian Parker is shifting to the coaching box from the field as the Cowboys add Mike Pettine to the staff as a consultant, but owner Jerry Jones denies his 32-year-old defensive coordinator is "overwhelmed." "I'm obviously disappointed in the results so far," Jones said Tuesday on his weekly radio spot on 105.3 FM in Dallas. The results are near the bottom of the barrel among NFL defenses through five games. The Cowboys rank 31st in total defense, allowing 395.4 yards per game, and 25th in scoring defense at 27.2 points per game. Parker worked under Pettine as a defensive quality control coach in Green Bay in 2019-20 and current Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer was on the same coaching staff as Pettine with the Jets. Schottenheimer said Pettine was one of two consultants the Cowboys considered hiring, but wasn't willing to share the other coach. Pettine's most recent gig was a support role for Vikings defensive coordinator Brian Flores. Minnesota leads the NFL in blitz percentage, creating pressure consistently without a dominant individual edge rusher. The Vikings (5-0) lead the NFL in sacks with 16. Jones said Tuesday the Pettine hire centered around the existing working relationship with both coaches and noted the adjustment period to changes in coaches, personnel and scheme on defense was largely expected. "You put that all together and you've got some work to do to putting that all in place relative to the challenges you have when you really get into the ballgames," Jones told 105.3 FM on Tuesday. Jones' on-camera reaction to the Cowboys' struggles against undrafted rookie free agent quarterback Jalon Daniels and the Buccaneers tells a slightly different story. And the move to add Pettine to the coaching staff seemingly underscores the sense of concern over lagging performance for the Cowboys as they prepare to travel to Green Bay for a Sunday night date with the Packers. Pettine was given the title of senior defensive assistant. His role will be evolving starting with this week's game plan at Green Bay, one of Pettine's stops as a defensive coordinator. He coached current Cowboys defenders Kenny Clark and Rashan Gary with the Packers. He also had stints as defensive coordinator of the Jets and Bills and was head coach of the Cleveland Browns Schottenheimer said he's "coming into the situation where he will be very comfortable and can help very quickly." --Field Level Media

item.title: Prysmian completa acquisizione Xtera, spinge su cavi sottomarini tlc
item.description: Prysmian ha completato l'acquisizione di Xtera Topco Limited, gruppo con base nel Regno Unito e negli Stati Uniti attivo nei sistemi chiavi in mano per le telecomunicazioni sottomarine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Prysmian (PRY.MI) ha completato l'acquisizione di Xtera Topco Limited, gruppo con base nel Regno Unito e negli Stati Uniti attivo nei sistemi chiavi in mano per le telecomunicazioni sottomarine. Lo ha comunicato la società con una nota, sottolineando che l'operazione rafforza l'espansione del gruppo nel settore delle telecomunicazioni sottomarine. L'operazione è realizzata in joint venture tra Prysmian (80%) e Fincantieri (20%). L'accordo del dicembre 2025 attribuisce a Xtera un enterprise value di 65 milioni di dollari Prysmian sottolinea inoltre che Xtera è stata recentemente scelta da EXA Infrastructure per il progetto EXA Meridian, un nuovo collegamento transatlantico di 6.552 chilometri tra New Jersey e Regno Unito. I cavi saranno prodotti nel sito di Nordenham, in Germania, dove il gruppo sta raddoppiando la capacità produttiva e prevede fino a 300 nuove assunzioni.

item.title: Striking unions and Centinela copper mine restart negotiations
item.description: Chile's Centinela copper mine and two striking unions returned to the negotiating table on Tuesday under a voluntary mediation process aimed at resolving a week-long work stoppage that workers say is affecting operations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chile's Centinela copper mine and two striking unions returned to the negotiating table on Tuesday under a voluntary mediation process aimed at resolving a week-long work stoppage that workers say is affecting operations. The Distrito Centinela and Minera Esperanza unions began the stoppage last Wednesday after collective contract negotiations with mine owner Antofagasta Minerals (ANTO.L) failed. The unions are seeking equal benefits for all workers, regardless of union affiliation. "Regarding operational activity, the reports the unions have had access to confirm a direct impact," the unions said in a statement, adding that the number of trucks operating at the mine had been cut in half because of the strike. The Distrito Centinela and Minera Esperanza unions say their members account for more than 50% of the critical mine operators, including shovel and drill operators, and more than 60% of mining equipment maintenance workers. According to the unions, the full impact of the strike is expected to be felt in November, when [USN:L1N45U10J TEXT:"production could fall by half"]. When the strike began, Antofagasta Minerals said the striking workers accounted for 22% of the mine's total workforce and projected production would remain unchanged.

item.title: Apple lança novos produtos para casa inteligente com Siri atualizada
item.description: A Apple lançou nesta terça-feira uma série de produtos inteligentes, incluindo um dispositivo semelhante ao iPad chamado HomeView, apostando que sua assistente virtual Siri, aprimorada com IA, possa ajudar a empresa a conquistar uma fatia maior do mercado de casas conectadas.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: A Apple (AAPL.O) lançou nesta terça-feira uma série de produtos inteligentes, incluindo um dispositivo semelhante ao iPad chamado HomeView, apostando que sua assistente virtual Siri, aprimorada com IA, possa ajudar a empresa a conquistar uma fatia maior do mercado de casas conectadas. O dispositivo HomeView, cujo preço inicial é de US$299 e cujas entregas começam no próximo mês, é a mais recente incursão da Apple no mercado altamente competitivo de dispositivos domésticos conectados. Ele contará com uma tela de 7 polegadas e reconhecimento facial, ajudando os usuários a controlar campainhas, termostatos e fechaduras inteligentes em um mercado no qual a Apple vem atuando há uma década sem grande sucesso. A empresa está lançando os produtos enquanto tenta se defender de rivais, incluindo concorrentes tradicionais como a Amazon.com (AMZN.O) , que investiu pesadamente em seus alto-falantes Echo e campainhas Ring. Na semana passada, a Amazon também lançou tablets premium. Novas empresas emergentes de IA, como a OpenAI, têm suas próprias ambições no setor de hardware. “A Apple precisa demonstrar que seus recursos de IA podem oferecer benefícios significativos além dos comandos de voz básicos, simplificando tarefas cotidianas e trazendo mais inteligência para o lar”, disse Paolo Pescatore, analista da PP Foresight. “A oportunidade é considerável, dada sua vasta base instalada, mas a confiabilidade, a confiança e a facilidade de uso determinarão, em última instância, se os consumidores adotarão esses recursos”, acrescentou. “A IA por si só não será suficiente para convencer as famílias a investirem em mais dispositivos.” Investidores estão analisando mais de perto as vendas de hardware da Apple em busca de crescimento, já que a receita de serviços da empresa vem sofrendo pressão regulatória. A Apple aprimorou os recursos da Siri com a ajuda do Google, mas analistas afirmaram que não está claro se sua assistente de IA é competitiva o suficiente para atrair consumidores para um mercado saturado de dispositivos domésticos conectados. Os lançamentos também coincidem com preocupações crescentes de que dispositivos conectados, incluindo geladeiras e TVs inteligentes, possam ser vulneráveis a hackers. RECURSOS ADICIONAIS O lançamento do HomeView da Apple foi acompanhado por atualizações em seu alto-falante inteligente HomePod e nos dispositivos Apple TV. A empresa também apresentou uma linha de acessórios, incluindo campainhas, câmeras e termostatos, fabricados pela LG e pela Schneider Electric e projetados com a ajuda da Apple. “É interessante ver a Apple fazendo parceria com a LG e a Schneider, já que normalmente ela gosta de ter controle total sobre o hardware que vende”, disse Ben Wood, cofundador da CCS Insight. “No entanto, olhando mais de perto, parece que houve uma colaboração muito profunda entre a Apple e esses parceiros para garantir que o design, a engenharia e a experiência correspondam exatamente ao que os usuários esperariam da Apple.” Durante um vídeo de demonstração do dispositivo, a Apple mostrou o HomeView -- que foi projetado para ser pendurado na parede ou apoiado sobre uma mesa -- e sua assistente virtual Siri atendendo a comandos de voz de vários membros de uma família ao mesmo tempo. O dispositivo HomeView não será vendido na União Europeia, pois a IA da Siri continua indisponível na região devido às regulamentações locais, informou a Apple. A empresa lançou pela primeira vez seu aplicativo Home para controlar dispositivos inteligentes em 2016, seguido pelos alto-falantes inteligentes HomePod em 2018, mas essas ofertas estão competindo com os alto-falantes Google Home da Alphabet (GOOGL.O) e a linha Echo da Amazon. Analistas afirmaram que dois grandes desafios para a Apple eram fazer com que seus dispositivos funcionassem com uma variedade de aparelhos de terceiros e a capacidade limitada da Siri de fornecer respostas úteis. “A maioria dos alto-falantes e hubs inteligentes nas residências hoje são dispositivos de baixo custo que não conseguem executar IA na borda, portanto, estão prontos para serem substituídos”, disse Mohit Agrawal, diretor de pesquisa da Counterpoint. “Amazon e Google mal começaram a atualizar seus hardwares para o Alexa+ e o Gemini, então o ciclo de atualização está totalmente aberto, e a Apple quer vencer essa disputa.” O preço de US$299 do HomeView da Apple está acima do Echo Show 8 da Amazon, que custa US$199,99, e do Nest Hub do Google, que custa US$99,99. A nova Apple TV 4K chega ao mercado por US$299, mais do que o dobro do preço de seu antecessor e em linha com o Shield TV Pro da Nvidia, enquanto as ofertas concorrentes da Amazon, do Google e da Roku custam US$200 ou menos. As ações da Apple subiam mais de 1% nesta tarde de terça-feira pelo horário de Brasília.

item.title: Brasil anuncia proyecto de ley para condonar deuda de 2.500 millones de dólares a microempresarios
item.description: El gobierno brasileño anunció el martes que presentaría un proyecto de ley al Congreso destinado a condonar la deuda de los microempresarios con el Estado y añadió que el objetivo es hacer frente a una deuda de unos 12.600 millones de reales (2.510 millones de dólares).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El gobierno brasileño anunció el martes que presentaría un proyecto de ley al Congreso destinado a condonar la deuda de los microempresarios con el Estado y añadió que el objetivo es hacer frente a una deuda de unos 12.600 millones de reales (2.510 millones de dólares). El Gobierno del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva añadió en un comunicado que también iba a poner en marcha un programa para adquirir la deuda de los microempresarios con el sector privado. Los microempresarios (MEI) constituyen una categoría empresarial brasileña simplificada creada por el Gobierno para formalizar a los trabajadores autónomos, como los repartidores de comida y los conductores de servicios de transporte compartido, así como a los propietarios de pequeñas empresas. El Gobierno señaló que la condonación de la deuda beneficiaría a unos 3,6 millones de MEI, mientras que el programa de compra tendría como objetivo adquirir unos 6.000 millones de reales en deuda con descuentos de al menos el 90%. Las medidas tienen como objetivo crear las condiciones para la expansión de las actividades económicas de los MEI, añadió El anuncio se produce menos de dos semanas antes de la segunda vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales, a la que Lula aparece detrás del senador derechista Flávio Bolsonaro en las encuestas. "Nadie quiere ser un MEI toda su vida, la gente quiere crecer; corresponde al Gobierno proporcionar las condiciones", afirmó Lula en una ceremonia celebrada el martes para anunciar las medidas.

item.title: Goldman CEO watching for election-driven volatility around data centers
item.description: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon said on Tuesday it would be interesting to watch for political volatility around AI centers ahead of midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Saeed Azhar, Pritam Biswas
item.content:encoded: Goldman Sachs (GS.N) CEO David Solomon said on Tuesday it would be interesting to watch for political volatility around AI centers ahead of midterm elections . Speaking at an analysts' call for quarterly earnings, he also said as the financing needs for AI projects grow and there is pressure on rates, it could affect the returns and the viability of certain projects. "Localized political volatility around data centers. You know, we've got an election coming up. It'll be interesting to see," Solomon said. "Obviously there's a lot of political discussion coming into an election, but then you also have to see how states and localities act coming out of elections. All these things can create you know volatility, and there's uncertainty around them." Data centers, which provide the computing power needed to train and run AI models, [USN:L1N43H17Q TEXT:"have faced growing opposition from communities across the United States"]. Residents have raised concerns about their rising electricity demand, the potential for higher utility bills and other environmental impacts on local communities. The artificial intelligence buildout is on track to require a larger share of U.S. output than the rollout of electricity, railroads, interstate highways or the internet, with an increasingly complicated financial structure that poses potentially systemic risks, according to a new study. The expansion will consume around 3.6% of gross domestic product annually through 2032, or more than $10 trillion, and is using ever more intricate financing arrangements, Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh, a finance and real estate professor at Columbia Business School, [USN:L6N45F0VB TEXT:"wrote in a paper prepared for a Brookings Institution conference last month"]. "There's going to be infrastructure built around it that's going to be quite significant," Goldman's Solomon. "But we feel very well positioned to bring the full range of services and participate actively, and we still see an enormous amount of activity." Goldman is a financial partner with Nvidia (NVDA.O) , which in August announced it has partnered with six major financial institutions to launch compute platforms aimed at raising over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure.

item.title: Wall Street tem variações moderadas em pregão volátil após balanços de grandes bancos
item.description: Os principais índices de Wall Street apresentavam variações moderadas em um pregão volátil nesta terça-feira, com as ações do setor de chips voltando a sofrer pressão de venda, enquanto os investidores analisavam resultados corporativos trimestrais mistos, incluindo os dos grandes bancos norte-americanos.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: Os principais índices de Wall Street apresentavam variações moderadas em um pregão volátil nesta terça-feira, com as ações do setor de chips voltando a sofrer pressão de venda, enquanto os investidores analisavam resultados corporativos trimestrais mistos, incluindo os dos grandes bancos norte-americanos. No S&P 500, as ações do setor de saúde (.SPXHC) eram as que mais pesavam, com a Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) perdendo 4,8%, apesar de ter superado as estimativas de lucro trimestral. O setor financeiro (.SPSY) contribuía para o clima de pessimismo, com o Wells Fargo (WFC.N) caindo 2,5% depois que sua receita líquida de juros ficou abaixo das estimativas, e o JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) oscilando entre ganhos e perdas após um raro resultado abaixo do esperado. O Citigroup (C.N) recuava 1,8%, mas o Goldman Sachs (GS.N) subia cerca de 1% depois que ambos superaram as estimativas. A seguradora de saúde UnitedHealth (UNH.N) também caía 0,2%, revertendo seu curso. O achatamento da curva de juros — em que os rendimentos de prazo mais longo sobem mais rapidamente do que os de prazo mais curto, um sinal de aumento dos riscos de crédito no futuro — pesou sobre os bancos, afirmou Kathleen Brooks, diretora de pesquisa da XTB. “Os investidores tendem a precificar isso com antecedência, e é por isso que bancos norte-americanos com grandes unidades de varejo, como o JPMorgan e o Citi, estão enfrentando dificuldades.” As esperanças de uma temporada de resultados sólidos vinham sustentando o mercado como um todo em meio a tensões geopolíticas, alta nos rendimentos dos títulos e preocupações com a inflação. Às 11h20 (horário de Brasília), o Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subia 9,14 pontos, ou 0,02%, para 51.859,69, o S&P 500 (.SPX) recuava 6,36 pontos, ou 0,08%, para 7.800,86, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) caía 32,52 pontos, ou 0,12%, para 27.213,38. As ações do setor de tecnologia da informação caíam, pressionando o S&P 500 e o Nasdaq. As ações de fabricantes de chips foram as mais afetadas após relatos de avanços tecnológicos da empresa chinesa CXMT. A concorrência da China “pode tirar parte dos negócios de algumas das empresas mais conhecidas, mas não acho que vá tirar todos os negócios”, disse Robert Pavlik, gerente sênior de portfólio da Dakota Wealth. A fabricante de chips de memória Micron Technology (MU.O) caía 4,5%, enquanto as empresas de armazenamento de dados Western Digital (WDC.O) , Seagate (STX.O) e Sandisk (SNDK.O) registravam quedas de entre 2% e 5%. O índice mais amplo de chips (.SOX) perdia 1,5%, no que Pavlik chamou de “realização de lucros em massa”. Uma alta de 3% na meta (META.O) impulsionava o setor de serviços de comunicação (.SPLRCL) , limitando as perdas no S&P 500. O ganho de 3% da Salesforce (CRM.N) continha a queda do Dow.

item.title: Report: Dodge close to making its return to Cup Series
item.description: Dodge is "very close" to finalizing its return to the NASCAR Cup Series in 2027, The Athletic reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dodge is "very close" to finalizing its return to the NASCAR Cup Series in 2027, The Athletic reported on Tuesday. Negotiations are ongoing but sources said Dodge is on track to participate in the season-opening Daytona 500 on Feb. 21. Dodge, which last raced in the Cup Series in 2012, will join Ford, Chevrolet and Toyota as the circuit's fourth manufacturer. Kaulig Racing, which currently fields two Chevrolets in the Cup Series, is expected to switch to Dodge, per the report. Kaulig Racing uses Ram Trucks in the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, and Ram Trucks and Dodge are both owned by the parent company Stellantis North America. Dodge also is in the process of finalizing a partnership with ECR Engines to at least temporarily supply its engines for the Cup Series, per The Athletic. ECR Engines is owned by Cup Series competitor Richard Childress Racing. Mark Rushbrook, global director of Ford Racing, told The Athletic last week that Dodge's impending return is a "good thing" for the sport. "So we certainly welcome Dodge as a fourth manufacturer," he said. "We welcome more beyond that into NASCAR. We want to compete against the best manufacturers in the world and to have more of that OEM (original engine manufacturer) rivalry on track. So certainly, if Dodge is going to come to Cup, just like Ram came to the truck, we welcome them." --Field Level Media

item.title: Albanian students protest over education, jobs, clash with police
item.description: Student protesters hurled bricks and concrete blocks at Albania's Education Ministry in Tirana on Tuesday and police fired tear gas and water cannons in response, as a nationwide demonstration over education and social issues turned violent.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Student protesters hurled bricks and concrete blocks at Albania's Education Ministry in Tirana on Tuesday and police fired tear gas and water cannons in response, as a nationwide demonstration over education and social issues turned violent. Police officers detained several protesters. Student organisers said the protest was over conditions at universities, higher education costs, financial support and employment prospects after graduation. Some protesters added they wanted to express their frustration with inequality and the government. "What Albania needs is a revolution, a change, a complete overthrow of the system because it can't go on like this," protester Luljeta Kola said, adding there was deep social injustice and a gulf between rich and poor in the country. The demonstration comes amid a broader wave of student activism in Europe. In France, high school students have staged weeks of [USN:L1N45U08J TEXT:"protests"] and school blockades demanding more teachers and better facilities, arguing that deteriorating school buildings and overcrowded classrooms are undermining education. Albania's Deputy Prime Minister Albana Koçiu wrote on Facebook: "Violence has not been, is not, and will never be a solution. Throwing stones, attacking institutions and the state police, as well as the senseless destruction of public property, are not how youth should express themselves."

item.title: MI5 chief lists Iran, Russia, AI and terrorists among threats to UK
item.description: MI5 spy chief Ken McCallum delivered his annual speech on Tuesday outlining his view of the threats to Britain, from hostile states such as Iran and Russia to the development of artificial intelligence.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: MI5 spy chief Ken McCallum [USN:L8N45Z17L TEXT:"delivered his annual speech"] on Tuesday outlining his view of the threats to Britain, from hostile states such as Iran and Russia to the development of artificial intelligence. Here is a summary of the main threats and issues he detailed in his speech and subsequent questions from media: RUSSIA McCallum called Russia, which denies involvement in hostile acts in Britain and other Western countries, "aggressor number one". He said it was escalating "hybrid" warfare, staying below the threshold that would trigger a direct NATO response. He said Russia's capabilities had been reduced by the expulsion of 1,000 officials from embassies since the invasion of Ukraine, which meant it had to rely on native volunteers and criminal proxies. IRAN Tehran is also using criminal proxies - to target opponents, Iranian media organisations and Israeli interests in Britain - and has expanded its hybrid campaign in the last year, McCallum said. He said operations connected to Iran had yielded more than 50 arrests in the UK, and that many had been aimed at Jewish communities. The other shift had been "Iranian ambitions to come at harder targets, like military sites", he said. Tehran also rejects accusations of malign activity in Britain. ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE McCallum said AI was "supercharging the cybersecurity contest between attackers and defenders", producing tailored propaganda and material for individuals. MI5 has caught potential attackers using it to try to improve reconnaissance and attack methodologies. AI-enabled drones added a new challenge, he said. McCallum said the greatest concern about the misuse of AI was terrorists developing bioweapons or even creating new pathogens. AI also presented a risk in itself. "Put at its simplest, human history has given us no experience of facing an actor which is smarter than we are, is capable of out-thinking us. This is genuinely novel and deserves the serious attention it is getting." TERRORISM Britain in April raised its national terrorism threat level to "severe", meaning an attack within the next six months is highly likely. McCallum said Al Qaeda and Islamic State continued to inspire plots, and MI5 was still having to respond to attempts to carry out mass-casualty attacks. He said the most marked trend of the last year had been the increase in cases where extreme anti-immigration and anti-Muslim grievances were tipping over into terrorist intent. An investigation into one 13-year-old who had been radicalised by extreme right-wing ideology had led to an unnamed foreign partner thwarting a lethal attack on its soil, he said. BREXIT On Sunday, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Russia had interfered in Britain's 2016 referendum vote to leave the European Union, something Moscow has denied. Asked about such interference, McCallum said it was public knowledge that Russian media such as Russia Today "came in pretty strongly around the time of the referendum", and there had been a certain amount of activity from trolls and bots. But he said Russian online trolling had been comparatively unimpressive.
